biomass_source: IPCC AR5 WG3 Annex III, Table A.III.2, 'Biomass - dedicated', median lifecycle emissions (min 130, max 420): https://www.ipcc.ch/site/assets/uploads/2018/02/ipcc_wg3_ar5_annex-iii.pdf
biofuel_source: Same factor as biomass. global_energy_mix.json names bioenergy generation biofuel_TWh, so the factor is reachable under that name.
waste_source: One value for mixed renewable and non-renewable waste: the biomass factor, following Electricity Maps, which groups ENTSO-E B17 Waste with biomass (https://github.com/electricitymaps/electricitymaps-contrib/blob/b7469384a7/electricitymap/contrib/parsers/ENTSOE.py#L123). The non-renewable fraction varies by country and year and is not modelled.
